articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Remix of teen Haaland's rap song hits No. 1; Spain to face Belgium
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the 2026 FIFA World Cup as we start the second day of quarterfinals action.

articles.headline: Álvarez's return could be Argentina's antidote to their Messi dependency
articles.description: A sense of celebration has hung over Argentina ever since Qatar 2022, even into this World Cup. That must change in the business end of the tournament.

articles.headline: South African FA say Hugo Broos remains in his role despite exit reports
articles.description: The South African Football Association (SAFA) have denied that Hugo Broos has left his role as head coach.

articles.headline: World Cup: Grades for every eliminated team as each exits the tournament
articles.description: When the World Cup ends, 47 teams will have been eliminated, and we're grading every one on how its run compared with expectations.

articles.headline: World Cup kit ranking: Which teams will look best in 2026?
articles.description: The 2026 World Cup will be the first with 48 teams, bringing a total of more than 100 kits! Here they all are, ranked from worst to first.

articles.headline: USMNT's Pulisic flopped at this World Cup, but does he deserve the blame?
articles.description: In his prime at a World Cup on home soil, this summer was Christian Pulisic's moment, but for a number of reasons, he failed to meet it.
